residency.test: From 2024: registered in the resident population register, or domiciled in Italy (where personal and family relationships are centred), or physically present, for more than 183 days.
residency.impatriate_regime: The regime for inbound workers exempts 50% of employment income up to 600,000 for five years, subject to qualifying conditions tightened in 2024.
residency.flat_tax_for_new_residents: High-net-worth individuals can elect a 200,000 annual substitute tax on all foreign income.

headline.irpef_rates: 23% / 35% / 43% on three bands since the 2024 reform

credits.name: Detrazione per redditi da lavoro dipendente
credits.note: employment income credit; the real formula has three ranges and is fully withdrawn at 50,000

local_tax.name: Addizionale regionale e comunale
local_tax.note: 1.73% regional plus 0.6% municipal as a typical combination; Lazio and Campania are near the 3.33% cap

employee.name: INPS additional 1% above the first band

employer.name: INPS employer contribution
employer.note: roughly 28-32% depending on sector and company size

self_employed.name: Gestione Separata INPS
self_employed.note: professionals with their own pension fund pay lower rates

capital_gains.financial_assets: 26% substitute tax on most capital gains, dividends and interest
capital_gains.government_bonds: 12.5% on Italian and white-list government bonds
capital_gains.real_estate: 26% substitute tax on gains within five years of purchase; exempt after five years or if it was your main home
capital_gains.crypto: 26% substitute tax, with an annual exemption that has been progressively removed

quirks: The regime forfettario lets small self-employed taxpayers with revenue up to 85,000 pay a 15% substitute tax (5% for the first five years) on a fixed percentage of revenue, replacing IRPEF, regional and municipal surcharges entirely. It is by far the most important planning decision for freelancers.
Employees are usually settled through the employer using Modello 730, which produces the refund straight through payroll in July.
The codice fiscale is required for nearly every administrative act, including opening a bank account and signing a lease.
Regional and municipal surcharges vary by hundreds of euros between neighbouring municipalities and are based on where you were resident on 1 January.
The 2024 tightening of the impatriate regime cut the exemption from 70% to 50% and added a 600,000 cap; the version that applies depends on when you moved.

reporting.who_must_file: Employees with a single employer and no other income are generally not required to file. Anyone with multiple employers, self-employment income, foreign assets, or rental income must file.

deadlines.what: Modello 730 for employees and pensioners, for 2025 income
Modello Redditi PF for everyone else
Balance of income tax for 2025 and first advance for 2026
Withholding and VAT payments via Modello F24

forms.name: Simplified return for employees and pensioners, largely pre-filled
Foreign assets and investments monitoring section
Annual employer or client withholding certificate

documents_to_collect: Codice fiscale and SPID or CIE digital identity for portal access
Certificazione Unica from each employer or client
Precompilata - the pre-filled return Agenzia delle Entrate prepares from third-party data
Medical expense receipts and pharmacy records (tracked by fiscal code)
Mortgage interest, school fees, and renovation works invoices for the building bonuses
Foreign account balances and asset values for Quadro RW - IVIE and IVAFE wealth taxes are computed there

penalties.late_filing: 120% to 240% of the tax due, with a minimum of 250 where no tax is owed
penalties.late_payment: 25% of the unpaid amount, reduced under the ravvedimento operoso voluntary correction regime
penalties.quadro_rw: 3% to 15% of the undeclared foreign assets, doubled for blacklisted jurisdictions

warnings: The employment income credit (detrazione) uses a simplified taper; the statutory formula has three separate ranges.
The regime forfettario is not modelled - for eligible self-employed taxpayers it produces a dramatically lower result.
IMU property tax, IVIE and IVAFE foreign asset taxes are not included.
